usage: agentbreeder registry used-by [-h] [--project DIR [DIR ...]]
                                     [--state-dir DIR] [--json]
                                     ref

positional arguments:
  ref                   kind/name@X.Y.Z

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR [DIR ...]
                        Projects to look in (default: .)
  --state-dir DIR       Local deploy state to read (default: the local state);
                        a project's stack state is always read
  --json
